Hi Liam / Medsprint team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — it was great to see the workflow for clinical intake. As discussed on the call, a few quick follow-ups so your legal/infosec and procurement teams have the bits they need for evaluation: 

1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm the version of SOC 2 you typically accept and whether you need Redwood's Type II report filed with a third party? We can share our 2026 Type II.

2) Data retention & deletion: please confirm the target retention windows you expect for:
   - application access logs
   - request/response logs (tokenized traces)
   - backups/snapshots of customer data
   - deletion SLA (time to complete a verified customer data erase request)

3) HIPAA scope: can you confirm whether PHI will be sent to Redwood in production (even redacted)? If yes, we'll route to our compliance team for BAA scope.

4) Vendor security questionnaire: I attached a short vendor questionnaire template — please confirm you want us to fill this and whether we should return it to procurement@medsprint.health or upload to your portal.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Medsprint.docx (stub)

Suggested next step: 30-min follow-up with our security lead + your infosec to confirm retention windows and BAA scoping. I'm free Tue/Wed morning PT.

Thanks,

Vanessa, thanks — quick answers from our side to get started: 

- SOC 2: procurement requires a current SOC 2 Type II report (last 24 months). If you can share your 2026 Type II PDF that should be fine. We may ask our audits team for a bridge letter if dates don't align.

- HIPAA: yes, Medsprint will send PHI for certain intake flows. A BAA is required before production.

- Retention expectations (initial):
   * access logs: 12 months
   * request/response logs: 180 days (we'd prefer 365 but can negotiate)
   * backups/snapshots: 365 days (we need point-in-time restore for 1 year)
   * deletion SLA: validated erasure within 30 days of request

We attached our compliance intake form and a short procurement checklist. We can take your vendor questionnaire; send it back to procurement@medsprint.health.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Vanessa / team — answered inline and with specifics so you can push back or pass on to procurement: 

SOC2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026. PDF is on secure drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/SOC2-2026 (attached stub). We'll provide a signed copy to procurement once NDA/portal access is established.

Retention defaults (hosted API / standard plan):
- access logs: 30 days retention by default; can extend to 12 months as an enterprise config (requires storage add-on).
- request/response logs: default 30 days (KV/cache traces masked); we can offer 180–365 days via opt-in with tokenization scrub and additional storage costs.
- backups/snapshots: daily backups retained 90 days by default; 365-day retention is supported for Dedicated and Private deployments only (we can discuss snapshot export cadence).
- deletion SLA: our standard verified deletion workflow completes within 30 days for customer data and logs; for Dedicated/Private customers we can enable accelerated erasure (7–14 days SLA) as part of contract language.

HIPAA/BAA: we support BAAs for Dedicated and Private customers today. For hosted API customers we have a compliance path but require specific ingestion-side controls and contractual terms. Since Medsprint will send PHI, start the BAA process.

Encryption & key management: all customer data at rest is encrypted; we offer CMK via KMS for Dedicated/Private for customers who require key separation.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2026.pdf (stub), Redwood_Backup_Retention_Spec.xlsx (stub)

If you'd like, I can join the call with Medsprint to cover the technical details and proposed retention configurations. My availability: Tue 21 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed 22 08:00–11:00 PT.

— Soojin

- Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II (2026) PDF — link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/SOC2-2026 (we'll also upload to your portal if you provide access).
- BAA required for PHI: we can execute a BAA; Soojin will lead on scoping and will follow up with standard BAA language.
- Retention/backup options: default hosted retention is shorter (logs/backups 30/90d), but we can extend to your requested windows (access logs 12mo, request logs 180–365d, backups 365d) as an enterprise add-on or for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Deletion SLA: standard verified deletion within 30 days; accelerated erasure (7–14 days) can be contractually added for Dedicated/Private customers.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Procurement: please confirm whether you need the SOC 2 PDF uploaded to a portal or emailed as a secure attachment.
2) Legal/compliance: please start BAA intake; Soojin will send standard BAA language and next steps.
3) Commercial: Marissa / Ben — I propose we create a scoped quote for Dedicated capacity + 365d backups and extended logs, and outline the accelerated erasure SLA as an optional line item.
